sentences.en: The completion of the Suez canal was a colossal achievement.
sentences.zh: 苏伊士运河的建成是一项巨大的成就。

sentences.en: Katrina, however, cannot compare to a colossal hurricane on Saturn.
sentences.zh: 然而，卡特里娜飓风无法与土星上的巨大飓风相比。

sentences.en: The leader of the separatists has made many colossal mistakes.
sentences.zh: 分离主义领导人的许多行为都是巨大的错误。

mnemonic: 源自希腊神话中名为Colossus的大力神
